title: [API tests] Return shipment PDF selection and pdfDocument test isolation
summary: The return shipment PDF handler now uses the P.Ret.Shpt. report selection instead of P.Return, so the API can produce a PDF for a posted return shipment. Three API pdfDocument tests are fixed by disabling test isolation and creating their own documents, and they are removed from the disabled list.
key_points: Return Shpt. PDF Doc.Handler uses P.Ret.Shpt. instead of P.Return report selection usage
Before this fix, expanding pdfDocument on purchase return shipments returned HTTP 400
RequiredTestIsolation set to Disabled on the three API test codeunits so data is committed before the HTTP call
Blanket order and quote tests create their own one-line document
Three tests removed from the APIV2 disabled-tests list
